blocking_findings.problem: main creates arbitrary --out before attach_reviews reads the core. The attach path never requires --out to be disjoint from core.output_root or HERE/execution_01 and never rechecks that those two reserved roots remain absent. generation_gate.read_frozen only requires output_root to be absolute. Therefore --out can equal or lie inside results/S40_declared_variant_generation or work/S40_declared_variant_generation/execution_01; creating the attachment directory makes a reserved future-run root non-fresh, yet attach can still return S40_REVIEWS_ATTACHED_METADATA_GATE_PASSED. The unchanged launcher will later reject the supposedly ready manifest before execution.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Before output.mkdir, resolve the fixed generation output root and future execution root and reject any --out equal to, inside, or containing either reserved root. Check both reserved roots are absent before creating --out. Recheck their absence in both prepare and attach immediately before publishing a success receipt or final manifest. Keep the launcher's own freshness checks as the final runtime guard.
blocking_findings.pass_condition: No prepare or attach invocation can create or reuse either reserved run root, and attach cannot report metadata-passed while either reserved run root exists.

blocking_findings.problem: prepare duplicates the actual S39 manifest, four evidence records, and loading review under freeze_preparation.actual_s39_records. attach checks only the preparation schema, candidate_sha256, and tool_sources. generation_gate.loading_chain validates the active top-level bindings but ignores the duplicated freeze_preparation payload. A manually changed core can therefore carry contradictory candidate_path or actual_s39_records provenance and still pass attachment when its two reviews bind that contradictory core.
blocking_findings.required_fix: In attach_reviews require an exact freeze_preparation key set and value equality: candidate_path must equal the fixed absolute CANDIDATE path; candidate_sha256 and tool_sources must match; actual_s39_records must exactly equal a reconstruction from core.s39_loading_manifest, core.s39_loading_evidence, and core.s39_loading_review; and the recorded zero-body-read, zero-pixel-decode, zero-scientific-import fields must have their fixed values. Then call loading_chain on those same active records.
blocking_findings.pass_condition: The provenance copy inside freeze_preparation cannot disagree with any active S39 binding accepted by loading_chain.

nonblocking_boundaries: The gate validates two different review roles and different required statuses, but human author independence is an external orchestration property rather than an authenticated property of these JSON files.
The S39 metadata and loading-chain checks hash small source, evidence, review, config, and input-image bytes; they do not decode the image or read any GB-scale component body.
A successful future metadata gate would remain a pre-execution identity check, not evidence of generation, video quality, exact-original VAE equivalence, or innovation.

authorization.required_next_step: Revise the two blocking controls without changing scientific settings, publish new source and protocol SHA-256 identities, and obtain a new independent source review before prepare.

verdict: REVISION_REQUIRED before S40 prepare or attach; no model or scientific execution was performed.
